kernel.selection: native T6050 G17S hardware; pinned gpu,t6050 driver selects ProbeConfig::G17M5 independently of the base T8142 backend

changes: Comment clarifies that M5 reports existing feature COMPUTE_NO_QUERY_ACCESS (bit 30). Mesa hk_queue.c:129-135 already gates command flag on that feature.

Kernel adds DRM_ASAHI_FEATURE_COMPUTE_VISIBLE_COMPLETION at bit 34 and DRM_ASAHI_COMPUTE_VISIBLE_COMPLETION at bit 20; no fields, struct layout, ioctl IDs, existing flags or feature bit values change.
abi.compatibility: backward-compatible optional extensions; keep pinned Mesa's own header, no blind header copy or kernel/firmware ABI change
evidence: Mesa src/asahi/lib/agx_device.c:707-724 zeroes GET_PARAMS buffer and supplies its size; kernel drivers/gpu/drm/asahi/file.rs:538-578 writes min(kernel struct size, userspace buffer size).
Kernel drivers/gpu/drm/asahi/g17/mod.rs:1129-1132 includes feature bit30; :2462-2475 optionally reports bit34 without requiring it from userspace.
Pinned Mesa hk_queue.c:129-143 does not define or emit the new bit20, keeping the command flags zero except for previously negotiated matrix/query flags.
Kernel drivers/gpu/drm/asahi/g17/command.rs:713-779 accepts old flags and sets visible_completion=false when new flag20 is absent.

Kernel drivers/gpu/drm/asahi/g17/fw/m5/initdata.rs:3509-3514 describes host waits for unflagged compute. Actual g17/queue/mod.rs:554-562 only marks a firmware source when visible_completion is true (or not required), and g17/fence.rs:168-172 excludes unflagged sources from firmware waits. This retains conservative host synchronization, not a firmware ABI mismatch.
abi.qualification: source inspection only; integrated compile and physical GPU/display qualification are separate

build.gl_api_path: zink over native Asahi Vulkan; not software rendering
build.runtime_dependency_evidence: Completed build receipt records ELF NEEDED for every installed ELF; clang/spirv-llvm-translator are build-only with Rusticl and installed shader compilers disabled.
